# Goal
Busan Station (부산역) Unity digital twin: scene `Assets/ChooGuard/Scenes/FpsStation.unity`, open in the running Editor (Main owns every scene change; the scene is saved by Main at milestones). This round opens the 5 evidenced openings in the protected source model non-destructively, extends the world beyond them, and closes the remaining tier-c items with new evidence.

# RESUME
The first spawn of every lane was stopped at ~21:25 by an API rate limit (the user reset it). Before anything else read your progress file `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/progress/<OldLaneName>.md` and the digest `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/resume/<OldLaneName>.md` (every step, last reasoning, results; full transcript path inside), plus your work dir `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/<lane>-work/`; continue from there, never redo finished work. Keep writing the same progress file.

# Read first (in order)
1. `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/plan.md` — this round: user decisions, the 5 openings, the source-override contract, lanes, rules.
2. `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/plan.md` (previous round rules: evidence tiers, frames, check_spec, KitValidate, kit types) and `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/verification.json` (baseline + still-c lists).
3. Your predecessor's report for your items (paths in your task).
Kit types: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-spec.md` (Slab, Room, ToiletRoom, Window, Canopy, Storefront, ShopInterior, DoorSet, Balustrade, WallCladding, FloorFinish, SuspendedCeiling, Escalator, Stair, ElevatorFront, Fixture, DisplayBoard, WallSign, ...).

# Constraints
- Unity: every `unity command` passes `--project-path /Users/um-yunsang/CHOOGuard` (another session may run a second Editor). Lanes may run ONLY: renders `unity command run_script --no-banner --json --project-path /Users/um-yunsang/CHOOGuard --timeout 120 --file /Users/um-yunsang/CHOOGuard/AgentScripts/CaptureRegisteredScene.cs --entry CaptureRegisteredScene.Calibrated --args '[["<abs pose.json>","<abs out.png>"]]' --timeout_ms 100000` (pose `{"width","height","verticalFov","position":[x,y,z],"forward":[..],"up":[0,1,0]}` in Unity world), `MajibangBuilder.KitValidate` on your own spec (`--file .../AgentScripts/MajibangBuilder.cs --entry MajibangBuilder.KitValidate --args '[["<abs spec.json>"]]'`), and `SourceOverrides.Preview` (READY: `AgentScripts/SourceOverrides.cs`, usage in its header; exact, accepted by Main: Apply/Revert tested) on your own openings file, with pose/out pairs to render before/after views. NEVER KitBuild, builder Main, SourceOverrides.Apply/Revert, eval, play mode, saves. If a command fails with a busy/compile error, wait ~30 s and retry.
- Frame: station UVY (model units ≈ m). World x = u*sin16.2 + v*cos16.2, z = u*cos16.2 - v*sin16.2, y = Y. Floors: 1F Y0; 2F Y7.0; 3F Y12.2. Box frame origin (-3.0, 33.25) rot 4.13° (`.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/box-3f/boxgeo.py` b2s/s2b). U+ = north, V+ = east (port side).
- Live geometry: `.planning/2026-09-23-video-twin/1f-implementation/geometry-after33` (check_spec default; Main announces newer audits). Tools: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/enhance/check_spec.py <spec>` (run each spec ALONE; 0 errors required), void scan `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/voidscan2.py AUDIT OUT`, door check `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/main-work/door_check.py AUDIT SPEC...`, walk routes `.planning/2026-09-23-video-twin/1f-implementation/walks/*.json` (keep them clear; propose new routes to Main).
- Evidence tiers: a / a-failed / b built; c reported with the sources tried. Positions from registered/topological evidence (registered cameras/SfM, registered boards/vector plans, OSM/Naver registered to UV, source geometry); appearance from the kit library. Label guesses [INFERENCE]. Naver lon/lat -> UV: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/public1f/naver-1f-uv.json` (+ register_naver.py), Naver per-floor data `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/Services23F/naver-indoor-harvest/` (README), OSM `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/PlatformSide/` (receipts.json). Registration service: `.tools/regtech/README.md`; requests as `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/reg-requests/<Lane>-<n>.json` or message RegTech7 (it runs the heavy jobs; never start your own feature matching).
- New data: web search, official pages, Naver/Kakao, blogs, YouTube walks via `yt-dlp` (≤720p) + `ffmpeg` frames, under `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-27/<Lane>/` with `receipts.json` (URL, date, what it shows). Disk is short (user directive): ≤ 400 MB per lane, delete clips once frames are extracted, no model weights. NO Unity Cloud at all (user, 23:20): no uploads, no downloads, never run `.tools/unitycloud/*`; files listed in `asset-library/unity-cloud-manifest.json` are not available — re-download from the original URL in the receipts only if essential.
- Protected source `FPSWorld/*`: only via the SourceOverrides contract (opening boxes), applied by Main. Never overlap-hack around it.
- Interruption safety: keep `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/progress/<YourLane>.md` current (done with paths / evidence / decisions / next steps) after every milestone and at least every ~10 tool calls. Deliver a first validated subset to Main within ~40 min, then refine.
- Another session (FPS gameplay dev) edits C# under `Assets/ChooGuard/**`; never touch its files. Skip formatters/linters/project-wide tests. Keep tool outputs compact.

# Contract
- Specs: `{"zone": "<unique zone>", "root": "실내 트윈 마감/<name>", "basis", "elements": [...]}` from a deterministic generator in `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/`; unique zone names (KitBuild enforces `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-folders.json`); check_spec 0 errors + KitValidate 0 errors before handing over. Builder-plan edits (majibang-plan.json, interior-spec.json) are requests to Main with evidence.
- Opening boxes: `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/openings/<Lane>.json` in the plan.md format; Main merges and applies with SourceOverrides.Apply, then announces the new audit.
- Messaging ids now: SouthGate2, EastExits2, SeamNorth2, KitExtend7, RegTech8, Main (`write agent://<id>`); a second wave (Evidence3F2, Conflicts1F2, Signage2) starts later. API rate limit: keep tool outputs and file reads compact; avoid many parallel web fetches.
- Final answer: spec/opening paths, generator, report JSON (each item -> built / fixed / still-c with sources tried), receipts, overlay/renders, requests for Main.

tasks.name: SouthGate2
tasks.task:
(Resume of lane SouthGate: progress `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/progress/SouthGate.md` (KitExtend: `KitExtend3.md` in .planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/progress plus the digest), digest `resume/SouthGate.md`.)
# Target
Opening 1: the 2F south gate '기차 타는 길' in the box SSW wall (inner face u = -13.63 - .0722 v, V ~50-62 ±6, y 7.0-9.4) into the source south strip (floor top 7.2, old over-track concourse with stairs/escalators down to platforms). Predecessor evidence: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/platform-side-report.json` (requests: south gate), progress `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/progress/PlatformSide3.md`, scratch `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/platform-side-work/`.
# Change
1. Evidence: find footage/photos of the box south end gate (walks toward '타는 곳 Tracks', the south concourse, ticket gates) — YouTube walks, blogs, Naver/Kakao panoramas; register frames via RegTech8 to pin the gate centre/width/height and what it is (open portal, glass doors, fare gates). 2. `openings/SouthGate.json` with the exact box (y0 = 7.21 so both floors stay), and `specs/full/make_south_gate.py` -> `specs/full/south-gate.json` (root `실내 트윈 마감/남측 게이트`, zone `south gate`): reveal/Portal (ask KitExtend7 for the type), DoorSet or gates as evidenced, threshold Ramp for the 0.2 step, signage. 3. After Main applies the opening: void-scan the south strip (it becomes reachable) — every stair/escalator well must be guarded, no void behind glass; add closures/guards or report source defects.
# Acceptance
opening box + spec (check_spec 0 errors on the audit Main announces after the cut, KitValidate 0), report `specs/full/south-gate-report.json`, receipts, renders from both sides.

# Target
Openings 2 (exit 9, east facade U ~4-12), 3 (exit 10, U ~48-55) and 4 (북항 port deck/bridge), plus the WORLD EXTENSION beyond them (the model ends at V ~117.5): the exit-9 wing (U ~1-13, V 94.5..~121, floor 7.0, 2F/3F elevator at (1.3,120.5) per Naver; OSM way 165346389) and the 북항 pedestrian connection (OSM way 987862341). Predecessor evidence: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/platform-side-report.json` (requests: exit 9, exit 10, port deck), receipts `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/PlatformSide/receipts.json` (OSM overpass JSON), `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/platform-side-work/`.
# Change
1. Evidence: OSM geometry registered to UV, Naver 2F/3F POIs, photos/videos of exits 9/10, the east wing and the 북항 연결 보행데크/통로 (news, blogs, YouTube). Decide per opening what is outside (tier c where unknown after an exhaustive search). 2. `openings/EastExits.json` (exact boxes, y0 above floor tops). 3. `specs/full/make_east_exits.py` -> `east-exits.json` (root `실내 트윈 마감/동측 출구`, zone `east exits`: reveals, DoorSets with exit numbers, signage) and `east-extension.json` (root `실내 트윈 마감/동측 확장`, zone `east extension`: wing floor Slab, walls/Room, Canopy/roof, Windows, ElevatorFront, stairs if evidenced, the deck with Balustrades, ground/context planes beneath if needed). Every walkable edge guarded; the far ends end at an evidenced closure (doors/glass) or a guarded terminus — no walk-off, no void behind glass.
# Acceptance
opening boxes + both specs pass check_spec (alone) + KitValidate after Main's cut audit; report `specs/full/east-exits-report.json`; receipts; overlay + renders.

tasks.name: KitExtend7
tasks.task:
(Resume of lane KitExtend7: progress `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/progress/KitExtend7.md` (KitExtend: `KitExtend3.md` in .planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/progress plus the digest), digest `resume/KitExtend7.md`.)
# Target
Kit code in `AgentScripts/MajibangBuilder.cs` (Interior kit region only) + `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-spec.md`. Predecessor: `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/progress/KitExtend3.md`.
# State
KitExtend6 already implemented `Portal` (KitPortal ~line 5465) and `Ramp` (KitRamp ~5527) in MajibangBuilder.cs (compiles, dispatcher cases 2525-2526) and their check_spec volume models; trials in `.planning/2026-09-27-openings-extension/kitextend-work/` (southgate-trial, ramp-neg-trial, shops-1f/infill before/after). Finish the rest; do not rewrite what works.
# Change
1. New type `Portal`: the reveal lining of an opening cut into a thick wall — params `edge` (wall line segment in UV), `y`, `height`, `depth` (wall thickness, both faces), `jambs`/`head`/`sill` on/off, `finish` (plaster/stainless/granite...), optional `threshold` strip; collider on jambs. 2. New type `Ramp`: a sloped walkable plate (polygon or edge+run, `y0`,`y1`, finish, edge guards optional, collider) for thresholds like the south gate's 0.2 step. 3. Serve requests from the lanes (SouthGate, EastExits, SeamNorth, Signage) and `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/kit-requests/`. Keep existing types' output identical (prove with KitValidate tri counts on specs/full/shops-1f.json and infill.json before/after). Keep the file compiling (dry-run KitBuild/KitValidate/Main/FirstFloorInterior compile checks via run_script with --project-path). Update check_spec.py volume models for the new types (`.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/enhance/check_spec.py`).
# Acceptance
Types documented in kit-spec.md with params/defaults/tri budget, test specs validate, previews rendered (KitPreview HideAndDontSave), conventions sent to the lanes that asked.
